contract: cancel_cover_search cancels an active search by requestId and is silent otherwise: any authenticated socket may call it; an unauthenticated call emits nothing and does not abort an in-flight search; cancelling an active search emits cover_search_cancelled {requestId} on the cancelling socket exactly once (a second cancel emits nothing) and the aborted search emits no complete, result or provider error; cancelling after completion or with an unknown requestId emits nothing.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.
force is not applicable: cancel_cover_search has no force or override mode.
Cancelling another user's active search (no ownership check in CoverSearchManager.cancelSearch) is not asserted: no known client offers a cross-user cancellation.

invariants.contract: cancel_cover_search cancels an active search by requestId and is silent otherwise: any authenticated socket may call it; an unauthenticated call emits nothing and does not abort an in-flight search (which then reaches the 10 s provider timeout and completes); cancelling an active search emits exactly one cover_search_cancelled {requestId} on the cancelling socket and the aborted search emits no complete, result or provider error; cancelling after completion or with an unknown requestId emits nothing.
